blocks.title: Revenue model and segments
blocks.text: KLA reports three segments: Semiconductor Process Control, Specialty Semiconductor Process, and PCB and Component Inspection. Revenue is derived primarily from product sales and related service contracts, mostly through a direct sales force.

evidence.quote: Our revenues are derived primarily from product sales and related service contracts, mostly through our direct sales force.

blocks.title: Fiscal 2026 scale
blocks.text: Fiscal 2026 sales were $13.58 billion, up 12% year over year.

evidence.quote: Sales for fiscal 2026 rose 12% year-over-year to $13.58 billion.

cells: Inspection, metrology, chemistry process control, software, and related services for semiconductor manufacturing from R&D to volume production.

evidence.quote: The Semiconductor Process Control segment offers a comprehensive portfolio of inspection, metrology, chemistry process control and software products and related services, which support the semiconductor ecosystem from R&D to final volume production.

cells: Vacuum deposition and etching process tools used in MEMS, RF communication, and power semiconductors for automotive and industrial applications.

evidence.quote: advanced vacuum deposition and etching process tools, which are used by a broad range of specialty semiconductor customers, including manufacturers of MEMS, RF communication chips and power semiconductors for automotive and industrial applications.

cells: Inspection, testing, and measurement of PCBs, IC substrates, and packaged ICs for quality and circuitry-related applications.

evidence.quote: enables electronic device manufacturers to inspect, test and measure PCBs, IC substrates and packaged ICs to verify their quality

cells: AI, high-performance computing, and data centers
The filing says these trends are contributing to semiconductor-industry growth and are expected to influence fiscal 2027 investment.

evidence.quote: High-performance computing (“HPC”) and data centers, supported by increasing adoption of AI, are contributing to industry growth and these trends are expected to continue to influence industry investment during fiscal year 2027.

cells: Increasing package complexity and value, particularly for AI and HPC applications, is driving growth in KLA's advanced packaging business.

evidence.quote: Increasing complexity and value of semiconductor packages, particularly for AI and HPC applications, is also driving significant growth in our advanced packaging business.

cells: EUV adoption in logic and DRAM, including high-bandwidth memory
The filing identifies new process-control requirements and growth in key markets as a long-term demand driver.

evidence.quote: adoption of EUV in high-volume manufacturing (“HVM”) for logic and DRAM memory, including high-bandwidth memory, which drives new process control requirements and growth in key markets for KLA.

cells: The business is described as historically cyclical and dependent on manufacturers' capital expenditures.

evidence.quote: While we do not consider our business to be seasonal, it has historically been cyclical

cells: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited accounted for more than 10% of total revenue in fiscal 2026.

evidence.quote: For the fiscal years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, the following customers each accounted for more than 10% of total revenues

cells: Revenue is primarily from product sales and related service contracts, mostly through a direct sales force.

evidence.quote: Our revenues are derived primarily from product sales and related service contracts, mostly through our direct sales force.

cells: International revenues accounted for approximately 87% of total revenue.

evidence.quote: International revenues accounted for approximately 87% of our total revenues in the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026

blocks.title: Inferred buyer archetypes — not named customers

cells: Semiconductor manufacturers, including memory and foundry/logic manufacturers
Inferred likely buyers for process-control offerings; the filing describes semiconductor customers as operating in memory and/or foundry/logic markets.

evidence.quote: Our semiconductor customers generally operate in one or both of the major semiconductor device manufacturing markets: memory and foundry/logic.

cells: Electronic-device manufacturers working with PCBs, IC substrates, or packaged ICs
Inferred likely buyers for PCB and component inspection offerings from the stated applications.

evidence.quote: electronic device manufacturers to inspect, test and measure PCBs, IC substrates and packaged ICs

cells: Backlog increased from $7.86 billion at June 30, 2025 to $12.57 billion at June 30, 2026; the filing attributes the increase to strong AI-infrastructure-buildout demand and cautions that backlog does not indicate revenue timing.

evidence.quote: Our backlog, primarily consisting of sales orders where written customer requests have been received, increased from $7.86 billion as of June 30, 2025, to $12.57 billion as of June 30, 2026, due to strong demand driven by the AI infrastructure buildout.

cells: Order modifications, pushouts, or cancellations are identified risks; backlog on a particular date does not provide meaningful information about revenue-recognition timing.

evidence.quote: there is increased risk of order modifications, pushouts or cancellations. Our backlog on any particular date does not provide meaningful information about the timing of future revenue recognition.

cells: Export controls, tariffs, and other trade restrictions could limit product or service access to customers, especially in China, and adversely affect results.

evidence.quote: Such actions by the U.S. government or another country could significantly impact our ability to provide products and services to existing and potential customers, especially in China, and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

cells: Some parts or raw materials may be available only from a single or limited group of suppliers; loss or disruption could affect deliveries and results.

evidence.quote: Certain parts and raw materials included in our systems may be obtained only from a single supplier or a limited group of suppliers.
